text:
maria: Heads up — external pentest kickoff next Tue (staging). Root goals: validate RBAC for reader roles, confirm KMS access model for evidence blobs, and verify audit logging + retention. Assessor will need temporary access to logs + ability to upload evidence to a presigned S3 bucket. No PII in scope. Questions below; can folks chime in by EOD?

steven: For ephemeral roles — do we want 1h sessions or longer? 1h may be tight for some tests.

maria: Prefer 1h as default to limit blast radius; can allow one 4h escalation slot with approval. We should log every assume-role event to cloudtrail and tag sessions with `pt:assessor`.

jordan: Agreed on 1h. Implementation notes: use STS assume-role with a session policy that narrows s3/kms perms. Example:
```bash
aws sts assume-role --role-arn arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/pt-assessor --role-session-name pen-test --duration-seconds 3600 --policy '{"Version":"2012-10-17","Statement":[{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["s3:PutObject","s3:GetObject"],"Resource":"arn:aws:s3:::redwood-pt-evidence/*"},{"Effect":"Allow","Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],"Resource":"arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789012:key/abcd-pt-key","Condition":{"StringEquals":{"kms:ViaService":"s3.amazonaws.com"}}}] }'
```
This keeps KMS decrypt limited to S3 operations and forces short-lived creds.

emily: On audit logs — ops wants 90 days for app logs, 365 for infra-level audit trails (cloudtrail). For debugging, we'll enable high-fidelity traces for any findings and export full traces on request. Otherwise default sampling 5% for app traces to reduce noise.

steven: For evidence upload, can we provide presigned POSTs that expire in 15m? Also do we need server-side encryption with customer-managed key (SSE-KMS) or use our own?

jordan: Presigned POSTs with SSE-KMS and bucket policy that only accepts SSE header referencing the pt key. Example bucket policy snippet: {"Condition":{"StringEquals":{"s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption":"aws:kms","s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption-aws-kms-key-id":"arn:aws:kms:...:key/abcd-pt-key"}}}

maria: Good. Add requirement that evidence filenames get a nonce + assessor id in metadata. Also require integrity hash in upload metadata so we can verify later.

devsec-bot: Created ticket SEC-4242: "PT access runbook + ephemeral roles + KMS grants + audit export" — checklist items added. Link: https://redwood.example/SEC-4242

oncall-ops: Re: retest/dry-run — scheduling dry-run Wednesday 10:00 UTC. Can we confirm who will be on-call and who owns rollback? Ideally an eng-runtime engineer + security lead.

maria: I'll be on call as security lead. @steven can you own rollback/runbook?

steven: Yep, I can own rollback. I'll prep a minimal rollback doc and a playbook snippet.

emily: For triage — create a shared spreadsheet with vuln severity, PR link, owner, ETA, and whether retest required. I can seed it.

maria: Perfect. Action items: 1) steven: create assume-role + bucket policy PR; 2) jordan: KMS grant & session policy review; 3) emily: create triage spreadsheet and post link; 4) ops: confirm dry-run invite. Follow-ups by EOD.

jordan: One more — confirm that cloudtrail ingestion to SIEM includes `aws:RequestTag` and session tags so we can map assessor activity to findings. Otherwise we'll lose context.

maria: Noted. Add to SEC-4242. Thanks all :thumbsup:
